Overview of Alexanarch
Alexanarch is an independent digital archive styled as "The Self-Governing Library". It is used to host, track, and permanently index text specifications, datasets, and creative works. Many of its conceptual files—including documents classified under its GOVERNANCE semantic family—deal with topics like artificial intelligence, algorithmic sorting, and machine learning models.
